cross_run_bar.improvement_rule: IMPROVEMENT-ADMISSIBLE when, in one admissible port run (registered_comparisons[0]), an arm's official pooled SLU-F1 is at or above 75.25 (the band top 72.75 + 2.5 pp) AND its paired SLU delta against the port's own lock arm has a CI95 lower bound above zero (the widened CI95 of port_extensions.noise_model) AND its per-row SLU-F1 delta has a widened CI95 lower bound above zero AND the twin arm aa agrees (aa inside the band). Otherwise no cross-run improvement statement is made; the within-run words stand on their own.
cross_run_bar.refused: cross-flight-no-replicate: a run without the twin arm supports no cross-run statement (instrument rule 4; scripts/checks/stage3_effect_floor_check.py cross-flight-no-replicate)
cross_run_bar.rule_3_note: the instrument's rule 3 admits a cross-flight arm only when its delta's CI95 lower bound is above zero AND the delta exceeds the in-chain replicate's own measured offset plus that offset's half-width; 2.5 pp is the value of that bar at n = 1,080 as the floor check registers it, so a measured twin offset larger than the registered one raises the bar for that run

noise_model._note: Noise model M1 (plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-tfrl-three-way-comparison-and-improvement-plan.md section 5 M1 and section 6 T2; closes P3 and P4): a second request-identical replicate of lock as a registered arm kind, a CI95 with the decoding term, and per-row F1 beside pooled F1. DRAFT: registers a reading rule, authorises nothing. Read by scripts/analysis/slurp_l338_port_column_read.py through scripts/analysis/paired_ci.py; the reader refuses this recipe unless copies, formula, max_replicates and replicate_arms equal the code's.
noise_model.formula: V_rep = mean over the pairwise deltas of D**2; SE_b = (hi - lo) / (2 z); SE_t = sqrt(SE_b**2 + V_rep); widening w = z (SE_t - SE_b); reported CI95 = [lo - w, hi + w]; z = 1.959964

pairwise_deltas.definition: D_ab = m(a) - m(b) for the pairs (aa, lock), (lock-rep2, lock), (lock-rep2, aa): three pairwise deltas per metric; m is the whole-roster level in percentage points
metrics: per_row_slu_f1 (mean over rows of the per-row F1)

per_row_f1.definition: per-row F1 of a row = 2 TP / (2 TP + FP + FN) with TP, FP, FN the row's word and char counts summed (the scorer's own per-row fields); 1.0 for a row with no gold and no prediction; the per-row F1 of an arm is the mean over rows. per_row_delta = the mean over rows of F1_i(arm) - F1_i(lock), with its own row-paired bootstrap interval (same draws and seed) widened by the per-row V_rep.
per_row_f1.reported_beside: pooled SLU-F1 in read.json contrast.levels.<arm>.per_row_slu_f1_pct and contrast.versus_delivering.<arm>.per_row_slu_f1
per_row_f1.why: pooled F1 can rise while the typical row falls (a lever that makes the Solver answer emptier); P4 of the plan

replicate_rule.family: scripts/flights/nx/l338_port_family.py (REPLICATE_ARMS, ARM_ORDER, sampling_block); scripts/flights/nx/l338_arms.json and the historical family are untouched
replicate_rule.meaning: The rails (rails.supply_variants.parse_perception_sampling_variants) admit exactly one twin (replicate_of the delivering arm, no arm_kind) plus replicates (rows {arm_id, replicate_of, arm_kind: 'replicate'} and nothing else), the twin and the replicates numbering at most 2 (R = 2); a third copy, a replicate that carries an axis, a seed, a decoding or any other key, a replicate before the twin, an arm_kind on a non-replicate arm and any other arm_kind are refused by name. A replicate differs from lock in its arm id alone; it is its own Perception and first-visit Solver visit, so it adds one Perception AND one Solver contact per row.

noise_model.twin_admissibility: unchanged: |SLU-F1(aa) - SLU-F1(lock)| <= 1.2 pp; the other replicate deltas are reported beside it (port-verdicts.json noise_model) and enter no word

added: noise_model (copies, formula, ci_definition, per-metric pairwise deltas, variance and rms, each cited to read_json)
changed: every ci95 field is the widened interval; interval.kind names the widening; rule_text.ci95 states it

widened_ci.definition: The reported CI95 of every arm delta (arm minus lock) is the row-paired utterance-cluster bootstrap interval [lo, hi] (10,000 draws, seed 20261018: unchanged) widened symmetrically by w, the amount that turns the bootstrap standard error into the conservative sum of variances SE_t = sqrt(SE_b**2 + V_rep). The point estimate is unchanged. V_rep is the second moment of the pairwise deltas of the three request-identical copies: the copies are one configuration, so the true mean of a delta is zero and the second moment is the variance of a delta between two independent decodes, which is the decoding variance of lock-vs-arm when the arm decodes as noisily as lock. The copies themselves keep their interval-only CI95 (they are the noise). Identical replicates give V_rep = 0 and w = 0.
widened_ci.interval_only_record: read.json keeps the interval-only contrast under contrast_bootstrap_only and its words under arm_words_bootstrap_only
widened_ci.small_sample_note: three pairwise deltas of three copies in one run are a two-degree-of-freedom estimate; the record carries n_pairs and the deltas themselves

words.HARM: unchanged (the historical rule over the widened CI95)
words.NOMINATED: the historical NOMINATED rule read over the widened CI95 (word_rules: lower bound >= the floor on the lever's primary metric, no resolved loss on the guard) AND the pooled lower bound of the primary metric > 0 AND the per-row lower bound of the primary metric > 0 (for intent accuracy the per-row mean is the pooled mean; for SLU-F1 it is per_row_slu_f1) AND the per-row SLU-F1 upper bound >= minus the SLU floor (no resolved per-row loss).
words.withheld: a lever whose historical word would be NOMINATED but fails one of the extra conditions is read NEUTRAL; arm_words.words.<arm> keeps hist_word and nominated_withheld_by

parity_band.basis: 8 lock-form readings of the same Thinking system on this roster (SLURP-EVO-FOLD-B-V2, n = 1,080), Q4_K_M llama.cpp, development numbers; band = [min, max] over the 8 readings of each metric (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-fold-b-comparison-baseline-and-improvement-plan.md section 1 Decision 1 table; collected in docs/results/2026-10-29-fold-b-comparison-baseline-read.md section 3)
parity_band.consequence: OUTSIDE-BAND on the port lock arm: S2 does not start; the declared deviations (design doc section 8, items 8.1-8.7) are read first, by arm and by contact node, and the owner decides whether the port is the comparison base (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-fold-b-comparison-baseline-and-improvement-plan.md section 2).
parity_band.rule: PARITY when the arm's official pooled SLU-F1 lies in [71.61, 72.75] AND its intent accuracy lies in [84.91, 85.74], both inclusive, on the official scorer's two-decimal percent. Otherwise OUTSIDE-BAND, reported with the metric, the side (below / above) and the distance in pp. S0 PARITY needs lock and aa inside the band and the run admissible under registered_comparisons[0] (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-fold-b-comparison-baseline-and-improvement-plan.md Decision 4 revised, :98).

registered_comparisons.admissibility_rule: the run is ADMISSIBLE as a cross-run comparison only when |SLU-F1(aa) - SLU-F1(lock)| <= 1.20 pp (the point delta of the two official column scorings); otherwise NOT-ADMISSIBLE
registered_comparisons.contrast: aa minus lock, paired per row, official pooled SLU-F1 and intent accuracy, this recipe's interval (10,000 draws, seed 20261018); reported beside the words exactly as the historical recipe does
registered_comparisons.on_not_admissible: no cross-run statement (parity, improvement over the band) is made from the run; the same-flight within-run words are unaffected because both sides of each within-run contrast share the run
registered_comparisons.registration_status: REGISTERED (part of the port cell and of the historical recipe's twin key)
registered_comparisons.role: the cross-run twin: the registered in-flight A/A (replicate_of lock: the lock's request byte for byte, seed 20260913, temperature 0); one further request-identical replicate lock-rep2 is registered beside it (port_extensions.noise_model), so the port program is phase-native-module-v1-c17 (17 contacts per row) and the registered caps follow it (generation 36,720 / FIT 73,440 / audio 107,264 for the flight; 136 / 272 / 347 for the smoke)
registered_comparisons.threshold_basis: the parity band width 72.75 - 71.61 = 1.14 pp, rounded up to 1.2 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-fold-b-comparison-baseline-and-improvement-plan.md Decision 4 revised, :98)

within_run_bar.unchanged: the bootstrap is unchanged: arm minus lock, paired per row (one row = one utterance recording, so the utterance-cluster bootstrap is row-paired), CI95, 10,000 draws, seed 20261018, floors 1.49 pp SLU / 0.65 pp intent at n = 1,080 (design same-flight-node-column). Noise model M1 changes what is REPORTED as the CI95: the bootstrap interval widened by the replicate variance (port_extensions.noise_model); the interval-only record is kept beside it, and the recipe's primary, guard, word_rules and word_order keys stay byte-identical to the historical recipe (the port words are the historical words read over the widened CI95 plus the pooled-and-per-row condition of noise_model.words).
